video_title: Karl-Anthony Towns and Josh Hart’s Contract Negotiations COULD Get Uncomfortable with the Knicks

quotes.speaker: Amin Elhassan
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns wants to stay in New York long-term
quotes.excerpt: I would like to stay in New York for the rest of my career
quotes.quote: It wasn't so much what he said, like this full-throated defense of himself, but he said, I would like to get my contract done. He said, I would like to stay in New York for the rest of my career. And then he ended it, and because of the way the Knicks operate, it wasn't like you had space for a follow-up, of course, shocker.

quotes.speaker: Amin Elhassan
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the discomfort of contract negotiations
quotes.excerpt: everybody's going to be a little uncomfortable around here
quotes.quote: Ian Begley asked him about, are you okay with playing this out through the season, or do you want to table contract talks? And he basically said, everybody's going to be a little uncomfortable around here. And I was like, okay, I like that.

quotes.speaker: Amin Elhassan
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' financial constraints with three max contracts
quotes.excerpt: The New York Knicks can't afford to have a second max guy
quotes.quote: The New York Knicks can't afford to have a second max guy or somebody in that second max program when you waited 53 years to win a championship. And we know Jalen Brunson is going to get every dollar afforded to him next summer or if he waits two summers from now. But Karl-Anthony Towns, he can't get his money.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns wants the Knicks to feel uncomfortable
quotes.excerpt: He wants the Knicks to be uncomfortable
quotes.quote: I think I kind of like Karl-Anthony Towns saying everybody's going to be uncomfortable because he ain't talking about himself. He wants the Knicks to be uncomfortable. He wants people like you to talk about, hey, this position that they're taking on the second apron as the champions in New York City is unreasonable, whether you believe it or not.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart is also seeking a contract extension
quotes.excerpt: Josh Hart also up for a contract extension, also comes without a contract
quotes.quote: Josh Hart also up for a contract extension, also comes without a contract. What about him?

quotes.speaker: Amin Elhassan
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart's realistic view on his contract situation
quotes.excerpt: it doesn't look like we're going to get an extension done
quotes.quote: He was a little more elaborative and he was a little more vulnerable talking about this. I asked him the question like, considering what you give to the game, fingers mangled, playing through injuries and everything else, what is this process like for you? And he basically said, it doesn't look like we're going to get an extension done. It hasn't really been any movement in the conversations. You want to have something, you want to feel comfortable, you don't want to have to worry about all the noise from the outside.

quotes.speaker: Amin Elhassan
quotes.summary_phrase: The power outage at the Knicks' facility during media day
quotes.excerpt: the electricity went out at the Knicks facility
quotes.quote: Funny thing is, and I'm not saying this is a conspiracy, but I'm saying when Josh Hart was being asked the question about how this could potentially affect the team's mood and their play, the electricity went out at the Knicks facility. Internet out, lights out, cameras out. I'm not saying anything happened, I'm not saying anything nefarious went on, I just felt like it was a fitting end to media day.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's response to questions about the second apron
quotes.excerpt: you couldn't ask me to give three facts or two facts about the second apron
quotes.quote: I did see what coach Mike Brown got asked about the second apron. When it comes to contracts and second apron, on my grandkids, if you ask me to give you two facts about second apron, I can't do it. I have no interest. Leon Rose trusts me with stuff on court, and I trust him with that stuff.

quotes.speaker: Amin Elhassan
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's approach to handling player contract discomfort
quotes.excerpt: The first thing we try to talk about is everything
quotes.quote: He said, the first thing we try to talk about is everything. We don't want to leave any elephants in the room. They'll figure it out, and we can control what we can control.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Windhorst asks for Eastern Conference contenders
quotes.excerpt: Name me the teams that you feel strongly are definitely going to be in the top six
quotes.quote: Name me the teams that you feel strongly are definitely going to be in the top six in the Eastern Conference.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Windhorst's assessment of Eastern Conference depth
quotes.excerpt: I don't even have Philly on there
quotes.quote: I don't even have Philly on there. And that's not an insult to them, that's a concept with the rest of the league. I don't know how Philly is going to be, I don't know about their health. Probably Cleveland, probably Philly, probably. I don't know. But that's what I'm saying. When have you ever said that?

quotes.speaker: Amin Elhassan
quotes.summary_phrase: Amin names eight potential Eastern Conference contenders
quotes.excerpt: Philadelphia, New York, Boston, Indiana, Cleveland, Miami, Detroit, Toronto
quotes.quote: Philadelphia, New York, Boston, Indiana, Cleveland, Miami, Detroit, Toronto. I just named eight teams without blinking.
